prompt: A horrifying drowned abomination lunging straight at the viewer to seize them, seen close from chest height: its blood-soaked burlap-sacked head stitched shut with fishhooks and wire, blank and faceless, thrust forward; its chest torn open with ribs splayed wide like a vertical jaw of broken teeth reaching for the viewer, black water and blood spraying; two impossibly long grey arms with extra backward-bending elbows reaching around the camera from both sides, black split nails dripping blood. Realistic dark oil painting, smooth tonal shading, no outlines, lit harshly from below by warm lantern light, deep black shadow above. Whole figure in frame with margin all round. Plain flat solid magenta background, nothing else behind the subject.
